name: Blindfold Girl
source:
A girl with a cloth over her eyes, seemingly blind. 

[Spoiler]She is the younger twin, her [url=/c172436]older sister[/url] being the priestess with golden eyes. 

She is the "string mender" who has abandoned her role... but to what extent?[/spoiler]

[Edited from the in-game description]
